admission.notes: Walk-up aquatics ticket for rec, youth and family/adult sessions. Pool rental available for groups. Padlock required (sold on site). Ticket booth closes 30 minutes before each session ends.

lap_pass.notes: Must be purchased in advance. This is not the $1–$2 daily ticket. All six lanes, 50m.

notes: 6 lanes, 4 ft deep. 50m from 6:30–8:15am and on Sundays and holidays; 25 yards at other times. Saturday mornings the team takes half the lanes. Tickets are sold at the rink, not the pool. Call aquatics at (212) 694-3660 before you go.
